newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen falling on large privatisations.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen falling on large privatisations.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to fall on Tuesday, pulled down by undergoing and forthcoming large primary market offers, which are attracting investor capital and interest.

They said the bourse was suffering most from the current one billion-zloty Bank Handlowy SA public offering, and KGHM Polska Miedz offering scheduled to begin on June 30 and worth at least 300 million zlotys in the domestic tranche.
Analysts said in the longer-term an extension of the 13-week sideways drift was the most likely scenario.
